chromwise_mm10.strategy: download one UCSC mm10 chromosome fa.gz, extract all needed strand-aware windows, delete fa.gz before next chromosome

meta.frozen_rule: canonical hexamer ladder scanned upstream -45..-5 plus AU-rich upstream -60..-1, TGTA/UGUA upstream proxy, and GU/U-rich downstream +1..+30; no mouse refitting.
meta.leakage_guard: Predictors recomputed from mm10 sequence windows; PolyASite repSite_signals used only for sanity counts, never as predictor or label.
